title: Pilot Study of Open Label Homocysteine Management Therapy in Levodopa-treated Parkinson's Disease
official: Pilot Study of Open Label Homocysteine Management Therapy in Levodopa-treated Parkinson's Disease
summary: This is a research study investigating elevated homocysteine in the blood of patients with Parkinson's disease who are currently receiving treatment with levodopa. We are evaluating if elevated homocysteine can be corrected using open label B vitamin therapy, as well as the impact of homocysteine levels on cognitive function.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Diagnosis of probable Parkinson's Disease according to Movement Disorders Society criteria.
2. Currently treated with levodopa at a minimum dose of 300 mg/day
3. Montreal Cognitive Assessment (MOCA) ≥15
4. Demonstrated capacity to provide informed consent.
5. 40-90 years of age
6. Estimated glomerular filtration rate ≥60
7. Absence of uncontrolled hypertension in medical history
8. Absence of insulin use

Exclusion Criteria:
